# Shieldwall Games

> Shieldwall Games Ltd is a small independent studio in Kent, UK (company number 12655497). Its theme is "One world, many games": the studio builds worldbuilding tools and games that grow from the same creative vision, and believes creativity should never be held back. Its first product is Vitus, a local-first worldbuilding platform, which has its own website at brothervitus.co.uk. Its first game is Ashborn CCG, a Viking Age collectible card game.

## Roadmap (targets, not guarantees)

- Vitus: in open beta now (Windows), planned to run for around six months, with Vitus 1.0 targeted for 2027.
- Ashborn CCG: in development alongside Vitus, targeting late 2027.
- Ashborn: Saga’s Tavern, a standalone, GM-led RPG simulator with substantial Vitus integration, following Ashborn CCG. No release date has been set.
- At least two narrative trilogies are planned for future games. The studio is releasing its tools first so people can tell their own stories in the meantime.

## Vitus

Vitus keeps a fictional world as connected entries stored as ordinary Markdown files on the user's own computer, with visual tools, story planning, quest simulation, campaign hosting, collaboration and an AI assistant that answers only from the user's own world. Full details, plans and prices are on the Vitus website:

- [Vitus website](https://brothervitus.co.uk/)
- [Vitus llms.txt](https://brothervitus.co.uk/llms.txt)
